blocks.text: This article provides a summary of all new features and enhancements for Zscaler Cellular.

Zscaler Cellular supports eSIMs (embedded SIMs) in addition to traditional physical SIM cards, providing flexibility for organizations adopting eSIM technology. This enhancement allows administrators to view, manage, and activate both physical SIMs and eSIMs directly from the Zscaler Cellular Admin Portal.

blocks.item: eSIMs provisioned to your organization automatically display on the SIMs page. The Form Factor column identifies whether a SIM is an eSIM.
Administrators can assign, activate, or deactivate eSIMs directly from the Zscaler Cellular Admin Portal.

blocks.text: To access this feature, contact your Zscaler Account team.
To learn more, see About SIMs and Managing Assignment and Activation for eSIMs.
The following user interface changes and enhancements are made to the Zscaler Cellular Admin Portal:

blocks.item: Added Refresh button to specific pages (SIMs, Network Events, and Login Tracker) to fetch and display the latest data.
Total SIMs, Used SIMs, and SIM State Overview widgets in the Dashboard support clicking the numerical value to go the SIMs page with approripate filter applied.
Added an option on the SIMs page to download the list of SIMs with their details as a CSV file.
Added support for filtering SIMs using tags from the SIMs page or SIM details page.
Added the Total Usage field on the SIMs page to show data usage across SIMs in the current view.

blocks.text: To learn more, see Understanding the Zscaler Cellular Dashboard, About SIMs, and About Network Events.
